methodology.rule: IF a (key) was previously observed board_changed=False, predict board_changed=False on its next occurrence.
methodology.ground_truth: recorded board_changed flag on each action event
methodology.trigger_definition: an action whose key was previously seen no-effect; = an A10 (d) firing opportunity
methodology.baseline: majority-class over all actions; here no-effect is rare so majority='always effect', acc = 1 - noeff_rate
